description: This Java source file defines a final class ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder which implements the JsonObjectBuilder interface. It provides methods for incrementally building an immutable JSON object, allowing adding, setting, removing, and streaming JSON fields, with support for predicates to filter fields. The class manages a map of JSON fields internally and offers methods to construct an immutable JsonObject instance, ensuring no duplicate keys.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating immutable JsonObject instances, ensures no duplicate JSON keys, provides various overloads for setting values, removing fields, and building the final JsonObject.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty instance of ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded methods for setting different types of values (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) associated with a key, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField at the location specified by a JsonPointer or a JsonFieldDefinition, using predicates for filtering.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonFields to the builder, optionally filtered by a predicate.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field by key or by JsonFieldDefinition, supports nested removal via JsonPointer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an immutable JsonObject from the accumulated fields.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of JSON fields in the builder.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the JsonFields contained in the builder.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JsonFields.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the builder contains any fields.
